narrative:
Material PL1__M62085FB exhibits moderate demand variability (CV=0.48) with volatile lead times (CV=0.65). 
The analysis reveals that lead time variability is the dominant driver of safety stock requirements (78.4% contribution).

Current SAP policy uses an undersized order quantity (45 units) resulting in excessive ordering frequency 
(2850 orders/year vs 56 recommended). This drives annual costs to $215,430.

The optimized policy increases safety stock to 1197 units (from 434) to achieve 95% service level, 
and raises order quantity to 2278 units (EOQ-based). This reduces total annual costs by $202,542 (94.0%), 
primarily through reduced ordering frequency.

Storage constraint (3995 units) is satisfied with 3475 units maximum inventory. 
Reorder point is set at 2188 units with a 5-day review cycle.

research_insights.selection_rationale: Standard variability levels support classical inventory optimization
